program.sp1_version_note: 6.4.0 is the SP1 SDK, prover and sp1-verifier crate release the proofs were made and are verified with; v6.1.0 is the Groth16 circuit release those crates embed. The `sp1_version` field of every receipt and of every framed artifact is the artifact's circuit-version string, v6.1.0 (source/armc-relation/script/src/verify.rs), not the SDK release
program.vk_root_note: sp1_verifier::VK_ROOT_BYTES of sp1-verifier 6.4.0: the root of the Merkle tree of SP1's own recursion verifying keys for this release, a constant of the verifier crate; the Groth16 verifier requires the proof's committed vk root to equal it, which is how a proof made with another SP1 release is refused; printed in every acceptance report's groth16.verify detail
program.groth16_vk_note: sha256 of sp1_verifier::GROTH16_VK_BYTES (sp1-verifier 6.4.0), equal to ~/.sp1/circuits/groth16/v6.1.0/groth16_vk.bin on the development machine and on the node
program.framed_proof_bytes: varies per proof, 2444 to 2447 bytes (the bincode-framed SP1 artifact; the raw Groth16 proof inside is always 356 bytes); per-size counts in batch.framed_proof_bytes_histogram
program.expected_identities_note: the published copy differs from the file frozen on 7 September 2026 only in the provenance paths of its `sources` block, redacted to package locators (REDACTION.md); every receipt, manifest and acceptance report of the batch names the frozen digest, and an acceptance report written against the published copy names the published one; every identity the verifier compares is equal in both

rule.text: one proof per held-out August row r in 600..=711; base = OFFSETS[(r - 600) mod 5], OFFSETS = [-2, +2, -15, +15, +30]; offset = base when 0 <= r + base < 712, else offset = -base (offset_rule = mirrored; rows 684, 689, 694, 699, 704, 709 at +30, 698, 703, 708 at +15 and 711 at +2 mirror); every outcome published, negative differences included

noise_rule: normative noise_int bytes per row (source/noise_august/noise_{r:06d}.i16; BLAKE3 per row in expected_identities_august.json rows[r].noise_blake3): randn_cuda_emul(seed=20260823, call_index=r-600), Philox4x32-10 key (20260823,0), counter (r-600,0,e,0), Box-Muller lane x in float32, noise_int = rint(sample * 2^12) ties to even, clamped to int16 (oracle/final/README_FINAL.md section 5)
